answer: New identities start on the lowest terrace of a trust ladder and climb only with graded work sealed by a fresh per-epoch cipher key, so one operator cannot reuse one proof across a tide of fakes. Each terrace locks a 25.000 POA bond, freed only after six epochs of honest work; a failed verdict seizes the bond, half burned and half to the reporter, demotes the identity to the bottom, and bans it 12 epochs. Forging 1.000 identities costs 25.000.000 POA plus six epochs of real work each; an honest agent pays 25.000 POA once. Limitation: honest newcomers wait six epochs for their bond back.
